**In one line**: Anthropic has reportedly tightened the rules on how Claude may be used for influence campaigns, weapons and surveillance.

### Key points
- The changes cover three areas: AI-driven influence operations, weapons-related uses and surveillance applications.
- According to Benzinga, Anthropic has set stricter limits on what Claude may be used for in each of these areas.
- The exact wording and effective date of the changes should be checked against Anthropic's official Usage Policy.

### Why it matters
As models become more agentic, the potential scale of misuse grows with them, from mass-produced disinformation to targeted monitoring. Businesses and developers building on Claude should check the updated policy text to see whether their use cases still fall within the permitted scope.
